```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-validation-summary
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-validation-summary`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): see rename_legacy_antibiotic_table() in
# the Partner Report's _setup.qmd. A dataset serialized before neoipcr
# 0.0.0.9002 carries no validation summary at all, and one built with the
# validation pass switched off carries an empty one; the section says which
# instead of failing the render.
validation_strings <- sR$`tbl-validation-summary`
summary <- reference_data$validationSummary
if (is.null(summary)) {
  no_data_table(validation_strings$not_available)
} else if (ncol(summary) == 0L) {
  no_data_table(validation_strings$pass_not_run)
} else {
  tbl <- format_validation_summary_table(list(summary), sR)
  if (is.null(tbl)) no_data_table(validation_strings$no_removals) else tbl
}
```
